About Dr. Michael Anderson

Chief Pulmonologist & Critical Care Specialist

18+ Years of Experience | Board-Certified Pulmonologist | Adult Respiratory Care

Dr. Michael Anderson is a board-certified pulmonologist with over 18 years of experience diagnosing and treating a wide range of respiratory conditions. He is passionate about improving patients' quality of life through evidence-based treatments, advanced diagnostic technology, and personalized care.

Throughout his career, Dr. Anderson has helped thousands of patients manage chronic lung diseases, sleep disorders, and complex respiratory conditions. His patient-centered approach focuses on education, prevention, and long-term respiratory wellness.

Professional Summary

  • Experience: 18+ Years
  • Specialty: Pulmonary & Critical Care Medicine
  • Board Certification: American Board of Internal Medicine – Pulmonary Disease
  • Languages: English, Spanish
  • Location: Phoenix, Arizona
  • Accepting New Patients: Yes

Areas of Expertise

Asthma Management

Personalized treatment plans designed to control symptoms and reduce asthma attacks.

COPD Treatment

Comprehensive disease management to improve breathing and enhance quality of life.

Pulmonary Function Testing

Advanced diagnostic testing to accurately evaluate lung performance.

Chronic Cough Evaluation

Identifying the underlying causes of persistent coughing through detailed assessments.

Lung Disease Management

Long-term care for patients with chronic respiratory illnesses.

Critical Care Medicine

Specialized care for patients with severe respiratory conditions requiring intensive treatment.
